profile.headline: Software Engineer at GoFormz
profile.summary: I seek to navigate the digital realms of computer programming and software creation through the mastery of universal concepts and the discovery of new and innovative techniques to apply them.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: Implementing and maintaining integrations with third-party services

positions.title: Software/Automation Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
• Designed and developed an automation API to aid in on-premises database setup
- REST API written in Python
- Runs UNIX commands to configure systems on the hardware level
- Database storage in PostgreSQL
• Helped develop API to implement new pricing model based on data usage
- Back-end API written in Python to collect and calculate customer data usage
- Was in charge of the on-premises portion
- Designed the data calculation algorithm to work with AWS and Azure
• Automated system setup, performance testing, and characterization.
- On both on-premises and cloud systems (AWS, Azure, GCP)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
• Developed next generation web application for writing estimates and claims for auto physical damage.
• Designed and implemented:
- Front-end in JavaScript using AngularJS
- Back-end REST web API’s in C# and Java
- Database storage in SQL and Oracle
• Worked tightly and consistently in Agile environment with two-week sprints and ten-week PSI’s.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Created WPF application pages for KPI Dashboard, providing grids and summaries for raw database data.
• Created SQL tables and triggers in the back-end, designed page layouts in XAML for front-end, coded model-view-viewmodel pattern in C#.
• Aggregated numerous types of data in SQL for supply chain, purchasing, and finance departments.

positions.title: Intern
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
• Created product pages for the website and edited preexisting ones using Dreamweaver
• Added and updated datasheets to the online database for the marketing team using CRM and Asana
• Worked with IT in managing the website and rolling out new changes using Kentico CMS Desk

projects.title: MIPS Processor
